crossRefs.note: Now when Jesus heard that John was delivered up, he withdrew into Galilee.
For Herod had arrested John, and bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife.
For Herod himself had sent out and arrested John, and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother…
but Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias, his brother’s wife, and for all the evil things which Herod…
added this also to them all, that he shut up John in prison.
Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him; and he was very perplexed, because it was said by some that…
